pages.title: Read the situation
pages.instruction: Read for the facts and the different priorities
pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: We needn’t have paid in advance
paragraphs: Fictional booking: room $100, breakfast included. Receipt: room $100, same breakfast $20, refundable deposit $50. Deposit conditions: assessed after checkout room inspection if there is no damage. Full advance room payment was optional. No real payment details are used.

pages.title: Why is the bill higher?
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Why is the total higher than the booking confirmation?
lines.audioText: Why is the total higher than the booking confirmation?
lines.translation: Por que o total é maior do que a confirmação da reserva?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The receipt includes twenty dollars for breakfast, plus a fifty-dollar deposit
lines.audioText: The receipt includes twenty dollars for breakfast, plus a fifty-dollar deposit.
lines.translation: O recibo inclui vinte dólares de café da manhã e um depósito de cinquenta

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I thought breakfast was included in the room price
lines.audioText: I thought breakfast was included in the room price.
lines.translation: Pensei que o café estivesse incluído na diária

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: It was. We needn’t have paid for the same breakfast again
lines.audioText: It was. We needn’t have paid for the same breakfast again.
lines.translation: Estava. Não precisávamos ter pago pelo mesmo café de novo

pages.title: Separate two kinds of charge
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Not according to the conditions. It’s returned after the room check, if there’s no damage
lines.audioText: Not according to the conditions. It’s returned after the room check, if there’s no damage.
lines.translation: Pelas condições, não. É devolvido após a vistoria se não houver danos

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: So we should keep the two amounts separate when we ask
lines.audioText: So we should keep the two amounts separate when we ask.
lines.translation: Então devemos separar os valores quando perguntarmos

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Exactly. We can show the confirmation and request the breakfast charge back
lines.audioText: Exactly. We can show the confirmation and request the breakfast charge back.
lines.translation: Exatamente. Podemos mostrar a confirmação e pedir a devolução do café

questions.prompt: Is the deposit automatically a duplicate charge?
questions.answer: No. It is conditional on a room check

pages.title: What was optional?
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Did we need to pay the full room price in advance?
lines.audioText: Did we need to pay the full room price in advance?
lines.translation: Precisávamos pagar a diária inteira adiantado?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: No. We chose to, but the confirmation allowed payment at arrival
lines.audioText: No. We chose to, but the confirmation allowed payment at arrival.
lines.translation: Não. Escolhemos pagar, mas a confirmação permitia pagar na chegada

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: That’s different from saying the room itself was free
lines.audioText: That’s different from saying the room itself was free.
lines.translation: É diferente de dizer que a diária era grátis

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes. The issue is one duplicate service, not every payment on the receipt
lines.audioText: Yes. The issue is one duplicate service, not every payment on the receipt.
lines.translation: Sim. A questão é um serviço duplicado, não todos os pagamentos do recibo

questions.prompt: Does optional advance payment mean the room was free?
questions.answer: No. The payment timing was optional, not the room price

pages.title: Check what was included
pages.instruction: Use the booking details to explain the extra charge

pages.title: A partial refund is available
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. Reception checked the booking and agrees that breakfast was already included in the room price. They can return the twenty-dollar breakfast charge if we provide the receipt reference; it may take three business days. The fifty-dollar deposit is different. It will be assessed after the room check at departure, so it hasn’t been approved for return yet. Could you explain which amount we can request now and which condition still applies to the deposit? We don’t need to give any bank details in this practice conversation
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. Reception checked the booking and agrees that breakfast was already included in the room price. They can return the twenty-dollar breakfast charge if we provide the receipt reference; it may take three business days. The fifty-dollar deposit is different. It will be assessed after the room check at departure, so it hasn’t been approved for return yet. Could you explain which amount we can request now and which condition still applies to the deposit? We don’t need to give any bank details in this practice conversation.
pages.greeting: I have an update for you!
